title: Flat cartoon
summary: A 10 s science explainer sample in a flat-vector cartoon look: generated scenery plates in three depths under a code-drawn key light, sky, labels and an original character rig that acts out the consequence.

craft: a new element every 1-3 s; the camera never stops
one key light per scene decides every shadow and rim
every code object has base, shadow, highlight and rim
the consequence is felt by a character, not written
every number on screen has a source in film.json

style.ground: violet space, dusk and night gradients drawn in code
style.type: Montserrat 800 titles and captions, Nunito 800 pill labels
style.accent: key-light gold and rose labels against violet; mint character
banned: pure black, grey or black outlines
characters or text in generated plates
characters, logos or looks taken from an existing channel
style.motion: slow camera drift, elastic pops for information, squash-stretch acting

generators: GPT Image 2.6 via Higgsfield: three transparent 16:9 scenery plates (far, mid, near), high quality, 2k
tools/sound.py: synthesised sound, mastered with ffmpeg loudnorm
tool.assets: tools/build.py fills tools/templates/ from film.json and writes index.html and compositions/

reference.name: flat-vector science channels in general; no single film

result.example_story: what if the Sun disappeared: Earth stays lit for 8 min 20 s, then the lights go out

from_story: one question, one event and one consequence a character can react to
every number with a source, approved before anything is generated
generated: three transparent scenery plates per ground scene (tools/layers.md)

fits: science and what-if explainers built on one fact or scale
intros and social posts under 30 s
series that need the same character and light in every episode
avoid: true stories about real people or events (use paper-collage)
product launches that need real screens
long narrated scripts (this sample has no narration yet)

licence.fonts: Montserrat, Nunito: SIL Open Font License 1.1
